note: Results of the 14 September 2026 Bangsamoro parliamentary election. The vote figures are the COMELEC certificate-of-canvass returns as published on barmmpelectionresults.comelec.gov.ph, transcribed here from the compiled tabulation rather than read off the COMELEC files one by one; the seat counts are as proclaimed by the COMELEC Regional Board of Canvassers on 16 September 2026. Re-check every figure against the COMELEC canvass before publishing any of it as final.

outcome.summary: No party reached the 41 seats a Chief Minister needs. BFP finished first on 31 seats and UBJP second on 30, leaving the chamber to be settled by coalition rather than by the count.
